cc:Work.dc:title: Runtime Programs
cc:Work.dc:description: Phase45 execution times divided by same-window TypeScript reference times for 23 program groups. Lower is better. The logarithmic axis has a visible 1x equal-time reference. P45 · geometric mean within each source program. Parentheses show case counts. The headline weights all 45 cases equally, rather than these 23 groups.
